subject: Native Chalk revision after the centring and tactile-depth feedback
reader: Parker, who supplied the screenshots and cotton-paper reference and is reviewing the running material

sections.heading: Chalk · marker and depth
sections.text: The selection stroke now crosses the middle of the writing. Labels fit inside their cards, and the paper has a compressed edge and a soft cast shadow. This review follows your latest screenshots and cotton-stock reference.

sections.heading: Centre the writing and its mark
sections.text:
Your review found two linked problems: the marker underlined the word, and the larger handwriting overflowed the old tiles. Compact line spacing now fits the handwriting. The words sit in the middle of the cards, with small glyph stamps above them. Each caption carries its own irregular marker, so a taller card cannot pull the stroke away from the word. 01 · After · the same saved theme 
Hacker, tactical and agentic fit. The marker crosses the caption; the switches use the same centre line. Compare with the previous build 02 · Before · the saved Last Horizon theme 
The previous build puts the mark at the lower edge and leaves too little room beneath the captions. 03 · Tree and pane tabs 
The selected tree row and TERM label use the same uneven centre stroke, with visual overhang beyond their hit targets.

sections.heading: Give the paper thickness
sections.text:
Once the labels fit, your cotton-paper reference sets the next requirement: visible depth. Controls now cast a soft shadow beneath a compressed cotton edge. Regions carry the same edge lighting, while the shared grain adds fibre relief. The pale palette makes those layers easier to judge. 04 · Pale stock · palette, buttons and rules 
The paper sits above its surroundings. Highlights and contact shadows supply depth without changing the palette or adding a bright frame. 05 · Your cotton-stock reference 
Your photograph sets the depth target: visible stock thickness, soft shadows and fibrous edges. This is the supplied reference, not a Terminal Delight capture. 06 · Attention spine and queue 
The queue, spine and response controls use the same stock depth. The staged cases are fictional. 07 · Paint cards 
The selection is attached to the name area of the card. Paper relief also reaches the palette tiles.

sections.heading: Carry this into the next review
sections.text:
The same material still follows the active theme. These final windows check pale terminal stock and the existing CRT warp. Your approved bottom-bar controls and messy marker character remain the reference for the next pass. 08 · Pale terminal stock 
The backing, pane rims and surrounding cabinet share the cotton material. Terminal type stays monospace. 09 · Last Horizon · CRT warp 
The terminal stock remains inside its existing warp. The cabinet and its raised paper controls stay separate. 
 Marker pigment 
Current choice: Complement blended 40% toward Human, drawn as a translucent stroke with a dry uneven score. It remains distinct from the live-state colour in the built-in palettes. 
 Paper depth 
Current choice: a compressed lower edge, lit fibres and two soft contact-shadow layers. Annotate a capture if the stock should feel thicker, softer or less raised. 
Your numbered screenshots, exact feedback and each corrective step are retained in the third-pass record . Notes on these figures can start the next pass from the same surface. Evidence and source 
Native fixtures: 1576 × 950 logical pixels on the 1.6× landscape display. Current-theme scenes copy the saved Last Horizon palette and display grade; pale scenes use Flexoki Light with a neutral grade. Terminal output and attention cases are staged. WebP storage is lossless, checked pixel-for-pixel against each original native PNG. 
Rio: 2,495 passed; Alacritty: 2,448 passed. Each has 9 ignored tests. Strict Clippy, formatting and release build passed. Logs, source hashes and the reusable native recipe live in reports/2026-10-20-chalk-marker-evidence/ . 
The renderer is in app/src/paper.rs ; caption layout and material integration are in skin.rs , main.rs and paint.rs . The verified build is installed for the next GUI launch. The running GUI and session host were left untouched; reopen TD to load the update. Your Chalk selection is already saved.
